# 查询人脸识别模块工作状态
##### 简要描述

- | 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| WorkState | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">工作状态；</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(206, 145, 120)">Initializing</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">,正在初始化，</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(206, 145, 120)">normal</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">，正常工作，</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(206, 145, 120)">recoverying</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">，数据恢复中，</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(206, 145, 120)">modelling</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">，建模过程中</span> | 是 |
| ErrorCode | interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">错误码</span> | 是 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceGroups/QueryWorkState HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: 930d157b-f6db-454c-8286-a7f541ef1d91
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 0


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Length:140
Content-Type:text/plain
Connection:close

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<FaceReco Version="1.0">
<WorkState>normal</WorkState>
<ErrorCode>0</ErrorCode>
</FaceReco>
```

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceGroups/QueryWorkState` 

##### 请求方式

- put
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
[]

```
